title: Epsom General Hospital, Dorking Road: planning appeal decisions APP/P3610/W/21/3272074 and 3276483 (fire safety treated at planning stage)
jurisdiction: England, UK (Epsom and Ewell, Surrey). Planning Inspectorate decision under TCPA 1990 s.78; a planning decision, not a building-regulations determination. COMPARATIVE NON-ALBERTA RECORD.
code_edition: Not a building-code edition record. The fire section refers to the Building Regulations approval process (p.24, para 124); no Approved Document or BS edition is stated in that section.

facts.text: Two appeals by Senior Living Urban (Epsom) Ltd against refusals by Epsom and Ewell Borough Council. Appeal A: APP/P3610/W/21/3272074 (application 19/01722/FUL dated 20 December 2019). Appeal B: APP/P3610/W/21/3276483 (application 21/00252/FUL dated 8 February 2021). Site: Epsom General Hospital, Dorking Road, KT18 7EG.
Decision: Appeal A is dismissed; Appeal B is allowed and planning permission is granted.

Fire safety (para 124): interested parties questioned the appropriateness of extra care accommodation in multi-storey buildings. The applications were supported by a Fire Strategy, and the Statement of Common Ground states that the fire safety provisions required in the Building Regulations approval process have been considered at the planning stage.

The appellant explained that the approach would combine physical design measures and staff training, and suggested a Fire Safety Management Plan as a planning condition. The Inspector concluded that 'subject to that condition, I consider that, for both appeals, fire safety has been appropriately considered at the planning stage'.
Fire safety was among the concerns raised in representations, alongside density, space standards, transport and parking.
The scheme includes Guild Living Residences and Guild Care units; the Statement of Common Ground records space-standard shortfalls for some care units.
